tei:div.tei:p: bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus las: 'chi med tshe sgrub lcags kyi ri bo bzhugs so: bdag mdun skad cig gis rig 'dzin tshe dpag med padma 'od 'bar du gsal bar gyur/ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog: o rgyan padma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin rlobs la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: bdag mdun gyi thugs kar padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur pha lam gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po nṛ dang āḥs mtshan pa/ de'i mthar sngags phreng 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa g.yas bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga yig 'bru lngas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus phyi nang snod bcud thams cad lha sngags su gsal ba'i gzi brjid kyis sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa ba gsum dang chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi tshe'i byin rlabs dang 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad dang*/ drang srong rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs/ mdor na sems can bsod nams can dkar po dge ba'i las sgrub cing dbang che ba/ rtsal drag pa/ 'khor mang ba/ yon tan che ba/ stobs dang snyan grags ldan pa/ gdul bya phrin las can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad yi ge nṛ'i rnam pa dang 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs kyi li li bdag mdun bum pa'i lha la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi a yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang : rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'grogs sum brgya drug bcu dang : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: tshe yi bar chad mi mthun rkyen: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: hrī: phyi ni bum pa nang ni bdud rtsis gang : gsang ba'i don ni padma tshe dpag med:

gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga'i: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: hrīḥ shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas lcags kyus khug: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas zhags pas khug: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas lcags sgrog khug: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas dril bus khug: steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin lag nas khug: 'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po'i lag nas khug: tshe srog chad pa mthud la yar ba khug: gas pa sbyor la nyams pa thams cad gsos: 'od zer dkar la 'tsher zhing snum la 'dril: spyi bo'i gtsug nas lus la sib sib thim: 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi a yu ṣe hūm̐ nri dzaḥ hrīḥ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa bcom ldan thub drug rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas gdab bo: padma'i yang sprul rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos gter nas gdan drangs pa'o: ༈ oṃ: 'grub par gyur cig rdo rje'i sku ni skye 'chi bral: tshangs pa'i gsung ni skye med rtag pa rdo rje'i gsung : spros bral thugs ni dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i thugs: 'chi med sku gsung thugs dang yang dag ldan pa yi: rnga sgra'i rgyal po rgyal ba 'dren pa 'od dpag med: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las 'grub gyur te: bdag cag tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog:
